title: Finite families of finitely generated field extensions have a finitely generated common extension
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], n a natural number, and K_i/k (0 <= i < n) field extensions [def-pc-field-extension], each finitely generated as a field: K_i=k(a_i1,...,a_ir_i) for finitely many elements. Then there is a field extension E/k, finitely generated as a field over k, and a k-algebra embedding K_i to E for every i. For n=0 one may take E=k. No algebraicity is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0H7K, lemma-common-extension-field; finite-family finite-generation refinement for Varieties Tag 04KT

proof.text: Induct on n. For the empty family take E=k, which is generated over itself by the empty set. For the successor case, use the induction hypothesis to put the tail into a finitely generated common extension E/k.

source.place: Tag 0H7K, lemma-common-extension-field; finite-family finite-generation refinement for Varieties Tag 04KT

proof.text: For the remaining field K form A=E tensor_k K. This ring is nontrivial by [lem-weil-common-extension-fields-tensor-nontrivial], since the structural maps from the field k are injective. Choose a maximal ideal m by [lem-weil-common-extension-fields-maximal-ideal]. The quotient Q=A/m is a field by [lem-weil-common-extension-fields-quotient-field]. The two tensor inclusions followed by the quotient map are unital k-algebra maps E to Q and K to Q. Each is injective because a unital map from a field to a nonzero ring has zero kernel.

source.place: Tag 0H7K, lemma-common-extension-field; finite-family finite-generation refinement for Varieties Tag 04KT

proof.text: Choose finite field generators of E/k and K/k. The image in Q of every pure tensor, and hence of every element of A, belongs to the subfield of Q generated by the images of these generators: coefficients from either field are rational expressions in its generators. The quotient map A to Q is surjective, so Q/k is finitely generated. Equivalently, the Lean proof uses that field-finite-generation is essential finite type, and essential finite type is stable under base change, composition, and quotient. Compose the old tail embeddings with E to Q and use K to Q for the head.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fg_common_field (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Fin n → Type u) [∀ i, Field (K i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (K i)],
      (∀ i, (⊤ : IntermediateField k (K i)).FG) →
      ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (_ : Algebra k E),
        (⊤ : IntermediateField k E).FG ∧ Nonempty (∀ i, K i →ₐ[k] E)
